vb_textbox.text: you have two keys to choose from. s or k they are two different coloured knomes. the first half you have to just pick which ever one you want. you have 1 and a half seconds. you then see another screen which you have to press space and it will tell you how many mushrooms you earned on that round.the game consists of two halves. the second half its exactly the same process, except you have to really concentrate but you get regular breaks for 5 minutes which you may appreciate. i did. this time ther3e are two colour groups pink red brown and purple and the other colur group green yellow orange and blue. you have to decide which of those two colour groups gives the highest points at that point and stick with those colours. then the mushroom amount goes down so you have to pick the other colour group. it sounds really complicated when you read the initial instructions, but its really easy.it requires a lot of concentration. it is also a lot to remember in a short amount of time. picking the colour group, only having that 1 and half second to pick and remember if that group is better than the other group.i hope that is helpful advice and i have tried to include everything i rembered.
